description: Use this when the user is stuck on a cryptogram or cryptoquote (cryptoquote help, cryptogram solver) and gives the enciphered text. Returns up to 3 candidate readings ranked against an English word list of about 25,000 words, the letter key for the top reading, the letters still open, and a confidence of high, medium or low with the reason. Pass letters already known (a printed clue) in known_letters. Short texts, names and rare words lower the confidence, and the tool says so; report that confidence to the user. English only; does not solve number or symbol ciphers, Caesar shifts with a shown key, or today's newspaper puzzle without its text.

allow_self_mapping.description: Allow a letter to stand for itself (default false; most cryptograms forbid it). Example: false

ciphertext.description: The enciphered text exactly as printed, including punctuation and the author line. Example: "GSV JFRXP YILDM ULC QFNKH LEVI GSV OZAB WLT."

plain.description: Plain letter it stands for. Example: T

known_letters.description: Letters already known, e.g. a printed clue. Example: [{"cipher":"Q","plain":"T"}] or "Q=T, X=E"

name: solve_cryptogram
title: Suggest cryptogram solutions
